006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
013
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.function.Supplier;
016
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * A set of constraints targeting a {@link IAssemblyDefinition} based on a
021 * target Metapath expression.
022 */
023public class AssemblyTargetedConstraints
024    extends ModelTargetedConstraints
025    implements IFeatureModelConstrained {
026
027  /**
028   * Construct a new set of targeted constraints.
029   *
030   * @param source
031   *          information about the resource the constraints were sources from
032   * @param targets
033   *          a supplier to get the Metapath expressions that can be used to find
034   *          matching targets
035   * @param constraints
036   *          the constraints to apply to matching targets
037   */
038  public AssemblyTargetedConstraints(
039      @NonNull ISource source,
040      @NonNull Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets,
041      @NonNull IModelConstrained constraints) {
042    super(source, targets, constraints);
043  }
044
045  @Override
046  public void target(@NonNull IFlagDefinition definition) {
047    wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(definition);
048  }
049
050  @Override
051  public void target(@NonNull IFieldDefinition definition) {
052    wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(definition);
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public void target(@NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
057    applyTo(definition);
058  }
059}
